scope: Read-only independent correctness review of CompletionWait, run_with_env, stop and Android screencap wait change

source_checks.conclusion: pidfd_open failure leaves no descriptor and uses the timed-sleep path; successful descriptors are OwnedFd, kernel-created close-on-exec handles.

Each pause recomputes remaining time and bounds it by the original interval; a readable child handle wakes completion, while invalid/error events fall back to sleep and EINTR returns to caller checks. No new unbounded ready-fd loop found.
Existing TERM grace, group SIGKILL, child wait and group-scoped descendant reaping remain present. A leader already reaped is still followed by group cleanup.

Overrides are added to Command after managed environment and before the existing child-specific USBMUX adaptation. No process-global environment write, env clearing, or unrelated host access restriction introduced.

run still checks completion before deadline/cancellation, preserves per-child process groups and parent-death binding, stops timed-out/cancelled children, kills pipe-holding group descendants before joining readers, and retains output/status/error contracts.

CompletionWait borrows the ManagedProcess child; all returns retain automatic group stop/reaping. Temporary screenshot, bounded wait, exit-status failure and validated atomic PNG publication paths are unchanged.

independent_execution.method: Temporary Rust harness compiled with rustc, embedding the exact reviewed CompletionWait, stop, parent_bound, capture, run/run_with_env and core cancellation source blocks. No product source writes or cargo rebuild.
limitations: Harness stubs settings-derived environment() to an empty override map and USBMUX adaptation to a no-op; it validates the exact process/wait/env-application code, not configuration integration.
The subreaper setting was enabled only inside the disposable harness process, never the shared agent host.

existing_runner_tests.note: Reran the supplied compiled test binary; did not independently rebuild the complete application. The intentionally panicking parallel-check fixture is caught and its test passes.

limits: No hardware, device discovery, installed application, UI, Bogen or global state changes.
No new Android cancellation guarantee: screencap already waits for child exit or its 10-second timeout and has no request-token check in this loop. This patch does not change that behavior.
Fallback and error handling were source-reviewed; forced fd=None fallback was exercised, not an older kernel or denied pidfd syscall environment.
EINTR source handling was reviewed but a signal-storm scenario was not executed.
No FPS, competitor, physical capture or real-device performance claim.
